Data and indicators

PeMS Station 5-Minute records provide average speed at mainline stations. Each road link connects adjacent stations on the same freeway and direction; the link value is the mean of the available endpoint speeds.

California Highway Patrol incidents are matched by district, freeway, direction, and location.

Weather records come from NOAA airport stations. Blue markers indicate rain in the previous hour.

Missing source dates are listed beside the time controls.
